items.title: Lecture 42 Appraisers Memory Course
Lecture 43 Appraisers Memory Course
items.script: Today we master the Vocab Link Technique. We don't memorize definitions; we build a phonetic bridge from the sound of the word to its meaning. 1. Amortization Sound-Alike: A-Mort-in-a-Size (A mortician—"Mort"—shrinking in size). Meaning: The gradual reduction of a debt over time. (Image: A giant pile of money slowly evaporating into a tiny coin). 2. Hypothecation Sound-Alike: High-Poth-Action (High-speed "Pothole" action). Meaning: Pledging an asset as collateral without giving up possession. (Image: A car parked safely in a garage while its owner signs a deed). 3. Assemblage Sound-Alike: A-Stem-Blaze (A flower stem catching on fire/blazing). Meaning: Combining two or more parcels of land into one. (Image: Two separate puzzle pieces snapping together into a golden map). 4. Plottage Sound-Alike: Plot-Edge (The sharp, jagged edge of a garden plot). Meaning: The increase in value gained by combining adjacent lots. (Image: A massive, glowing "plus sign" (+) hovering over a large field). Instruction: When you hear the word, the sound-alike will appear, and it will immediately drag the meaning with it. 1. The Amortization Weld New Word → A-Mort-in-a-Size → Meaning (Gradual debt reduction) Visualize a pale, spindly mortician named Mort standing on a mountain of debt—a massive, cold stack of $100 bills. As you watch, Mort begins to shrink in size, letting out a high-pitched squeal. As he gets smaller, the mountain of money beneath him begins to dissolve like sugar in hot water. You can smell the musty scent of old paper as the pile vanishes, leaving only a single, tiny, shiny penny. The shrinking Mort is physically crushing the debt out of existence. 2. The Hypothecation Weld New Word → High-Poth-Action → Meaning (Pledging collateral while keeping it) Imagine you are driving your favorite car through a zone of High-Poth-Action, where the road is exploding with deep potholes. You hear the "THUD-CRUNCH" of the tires hitting the pavement. To pay for the repairs, you sign a glowing contract that stays in your pocket, but the car remains safely in your hands. You feel the smooth leather steering wheel and smell the new-car scent, knowing that even though the bank "owns" the risk, you are still the one feeling the vibration of the road. 3. The Assemblage Weld New Word → A-Stem-Blaze → Meaning (Combining land parcels) You are holding a single green flower Stem that suddenly bursts into a brilliant, hot Blaze. The heat is intense, smelling like a summer bonfire. As the stem burns, it acts like a magnet, violently dragging two separate dirt lots across the earth toward you. You hear the thunderous "BOOM" as the two parcels of land slam into each other, fusing into one giant, smoking piece of real estate that glows with the heat of the fire. 4. The Plottage Weld New Word → Plot-Edge → Meaning (Value increase from combining) You run your finger along the razor-sharp Plot-Edge of a small piece of land, and it draws a drop of blood that smells metallic. Suddenly, that edge begins to grow and expand, pulling in the neighboring lot. As the two lots touch, a giant, blindingly bright Plus Sign (+) erupts from the soil, throwing off sparks that sound like fireworks. You feel the ground shake as the value literally inflates the earth, making it rise up like a golden mountain. 1. Amortization Sound-Alike Prompt: What does that word sound like to you? The Pause: Take a moment to let the sound-alike image fight with the meaning in your mind. The Reveal: Meaning: The gradual reduction of a debt over time. Remember Mort shrinking until the pile of money disappears. 2. Hypothecation Sound-Alike Prompt: What does that word sound like to you? The Pause: Take a moment to let the sound-alike image fight with the meaning in your mind. The Reveal: Meaning: Pledging an asset as collateral without giving up possession. Remember the pothole action while you keep driving the car. 3. Assemblage Sound-Alike Prompt: What does that word sound like to you? The Pause: Take a moment to let the sound-alike image fight with the meaning in your mind. The Reveal: Meaning: Combining two or more parcels of land into one. Remember the blazing stem pulling the lots together with a boom. 4. Plottage Sound-Alike Prompt: What does that word sound like to you? The Pause: Take a moment to let the sound-alike image fight with the meaning in your mind. The Reveal: Meaning: The increase in value from combining lots. Remember the sharp edge and the glowing plus sign inflating the land's value. If the image is clear enough to recall instantly, you’ve done it right. [SCENE END]
